activities.name: LookupTables
activities.description: Get all tables for all schemas - list for export

sqlReaderQuery.value:
SELECT 
'[' + SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) + '].[' + t.name + ']' as 'table_plus_schema'
, SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) as 'table_schema'
, t.name as 'table_name'
, '' + SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) + '.' + t.name + '_' + '@{pipeline().parameters.files_postfix}' + '.bck'  as fileName
,ntile(4) over (order by newid()) as grp
  FROM sys.tables t 
LEFT JOIN sys.external_tables e
on t.object_id = e.object_id
where e.type is NULL
